continuity.campaign_development: July 59 BCE: Valerius completes the field survey of the former bandit-held lands granted in Round 53, measuring the aggregate at 2.8125 square miles (1,800 acres). The fortified store-yard and winter-pass complex is measured separately at 0.0625 square miles (40 acres) as a component of the pre-existing holdings, not a duplicate addition. The formal measured personal total becomes 7.0625 square miles (4,520 acres).
continuity.land_area_history: Round 33 establishes 4.00 square miles; Round 42 adds 0.25 sq mi; Round 53 establishes ownership of the former bandit-held lands pending survey; Round 55 measures that aggregate at 2.8125 sq mi and updates the measured personal total to 7.0625 sq mi. The 0.0625 sq mi fort complex is a component measurement inside the pre-existing holdings and is not added twice.

character_registry.rule: Recurring named characters are persistent simulation entities. Established characters must be considered during every round and reused by name when contextually involved. Generic labels may be used only for genuinely unidentified groups or when no named individual is supported by prior continuity.

event_variety_policy.rule: Do not make every event about the same subject. Prefer distinct news dimensions supported by current state: military operations, intelligence, logistics, political relationships, economic/property activity, social/local developments, personal developments, geography, and reactions. Variety must arise from simulation context and must not be fabricated solely to fill slots.

exact_quantity_rule: Exact quantities retain their explicit units and are not converted into condition points.
